Founder CHAR-001 always presents the product, Cristu CHAR-004 is the business owner, Kiana CHAR-002 is the customer. Main accepts the request; Executive/Director coordinates department work. This is CPU draft preparation only, not a GPU grant, still approval, production QC or delivery authorization.

source_request.prompt: Create ONE proposed production opening frame, portrait 576x1024,9:16. Image1 shows two reference views of the SAME adult Cristu, not two characters: use the large close-up for his exact facial identity and the full-body view for his approved navy suit, white shirt, pale gold striped tie and brown shoes. Preserve Cristu's face, brown eyes, warm brown skin, short beard, tied-back loc hairstyle, hairline and body proportions. Only ONE man appears. Image2 is the approved executive office: preserve its windows, desk, shelves, spatial layout and materials. Cristu sits alone behind the desk late at night. Eye-level medium-close portrait composition, with his whole face clearly visible in the upper-middle area, shoulders relaxed but tired; subtle exhausted expression, closed mouth, no smile or grimace. His hands rest naturally and separately on the desk, away from his face. A single dark smartphone lies screen-up beside one hand, and a laptop stays off to the side. Leave the phone screen plain and dark, without generated text; message notifications will be composited later. Cool dark blue nighttime window light, warm desk-lamp illumination on one side of his face, cinematic depth of field. Match approved premium stylized3D artwork. Clear face and hands; no physical redesign. No Founder or other people in this shot. No duplicated characters, insets, grids, panels, captions, logos, readable text, face in reflections, extra hands or fingers. This still begins a slow push-in; leave useful portrait framing around head and shoulders.
